import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();

        if (n > m) {
            long temp = n;
            n = m;
            m = temp;
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            // Python: m // 6 + (m + 1) // 6 + (m + 2) // 6 << 1
            // In Python, << has lower precedence than +
            long result = (m / 6) + ((m + 1) / 6) + ((m + 2) / 6);
            System.out.println(result << 1);
        } else if (n == 2) {
            // Python: 0 if m == 2 else 4 if m == 3 else 12 if m == 7 else n * m
            if (m == 2) {
                System.out.println(0);
            } else if (m == 3) {
                System.out.println(4);
            } else if (m == 7) {
                System.out.println(12);
            } else {
                System.out.println(n * m);
            }
        } else {
            // Python: n * m >> 1 << 1
            // In Python, >> and << have the same precedence and are evaluated left-to-right
            long result = (n * m) >> 1;
            System.out.println(result << 1);
        }
    }
}
